Architecture · Turion Space · ETO Operating Reality
Sales decides who + when.
Engineering decides what.
NetSuite ties both to a satellite.

A working illustration of the four-system architecture for SAT-001. Click into any of the four product views below to see how each system holds its piece of the truth · then how it lands in NetSuite for planning, manufacturing, and revenue.

FULL LIFECYCLE WALKTHROUGH · 16 STEPS · 7 PHASES · LIVE DATA
SAT-001 End-to-End · Salesforce → NetSuite → MES → QMS → Cash
Watch one $47.8M USSF satellite flow through every system: SF Account + Opp → Celigo sync → NS Customer + SO + 7 CLINs + ARM → JE booking backlog → Arena BOM (93 lines) + ECOs → MRP + 14 POs → EDI 850/855/856/810 with Blue Canyon → 3-way match → AP JE → MES (8 stages: Receiving · Sub-assy · Subsystem · Bus integration (current) · Functional · Environmental · Final assy · DCMA accept) → NCRs/CAPAs/audits → milestone billing + revenue recognition (ASC 606) → invoice → NACHA cash → period close. Press ▶ Play to auto-advance · use ←/→ keys for manual.
▶ Start walkthrough
Or open the older 10-step workflow →
NetSuite modules · 7 functional walk-throughs

Pick the seat →

👁 Role Dashboards · function-specific (legacy)
CFO · CTO · Programs · Procurement · DCMA · function-tailored views
CFO · TB DR=CR · AR/AP aging · 16-step close · indirect rate true-up
CTO · MES stage progress · NCR/CAPA cycle · ECO cadence · ITAR posture
Programs · BAC/EV/AC chart · CDRL · risk register · variance
Procurement · open POs · vendor scorecard · slip alerts · sub-supplier change
DCMA · NCR/CAPA trail · audit findings · ITAR access log · DPAS cascade
Open list →
⇄ Migration tools — bring your old books into NetSuite

Show the team the migration story: QuickBooks and Ramp data flowing into the live NetSuite tables, with the full field-map visible at every step. Three-pane wizard, idempotent migrate, full audit trail per click.

QB
QuickBooks → NetSuite
Interactive migration walkthrough
6 record types · COA, Customers, Vendors, Items, Invoices+Payments, Bills+Bill-Payments
3-pane wizard · QB rows → field-map → NetSuite preview
Real DB persistence · migration_runs + audit_log per run
Idempotent re-migrate · "View in NetSuite" deep-links to existing pages
Open migration →
Ramp
Ramp → NetSuite
Corporate card → Expense / Bill
Card txns auto-categorized to GL accounts (Ramp's category guess → NS line account)
Same 3-pane treatment as the QB wizard for a single record type
Each Ramp txn becomes a single-line Bill against synthetic vendor "Ramp · Corporate Card"
Receipt URL preserved as NS attachment
Open Ramp module →
Two integration boundaries · what each connector moves
1 · Salesforce → NetSuite
CRM → Financial / Project
SF Account closed-won → NS Customer record (idempotent on Account ID)
SF Opportunity → NS Sales Order with CLINs as line items
SF Contract → NS customrecord_contract (FFP terms preserved)
SF CLIN schedule → ARM revenue arrangements per performance obligation
SF CDRL → NS Project Tasks with due dates
SF Period of Performance → SO need date drives MRP demand
NS PO release (EDI 850) → Vendor Portal · vendor accept/counter/reject (EDI 855) flows back
2 · Arena → NetSuite
Engineering → Financial / MRP
Arena Item Master → NS Item record (idempotent on part-number)
Arena Multi-level BOM → NS Bill of Materials (effectivity respected)
Arena AML → NS Vendor list with preferred-vendor flag
Arena ECO release → NS customrecord_eco with disposition
Arena Routings → NS Manufacturing Routing + MES traveler
Arena Documents → NS Item URL refs (ITAR access inherits)
Arena QMS NCR → MES NCR record + supplier scorecard
Arena QMS CAPA → linked to Arena ECO + tracked through to next-build verification
Presented by Jithesh Manoharan · jeetnair.in@gmail.com · For Thursday 7 May 2026 architecture review
